content: The continuous use of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems is linked to a significant reduction in anxiety related to fluctuations in blood glucose levels. This technology also contributes to a lower risk of developing complications associated with diabetes. By providing real-time feedback on glucose levels, CGM enables users to make prompt and informed adjustments to their lifestyle and treatment regimen. This capability fosters a sense of control and empowerment, ultimately enhancing the overall quality of life for individuals with diabetes as well as their caregivers.
